name: Ephraim (United States)
description: Vertical bicolour of Scandinavian blue and red, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing a black hawk before a tree, for the Black Hawk War and the Peace Treaty Tree.
history: Ephraim is a city in Sanpete County, Utah. The flag was adopted on 5 February 2020 (designed by Tara Daniel's sixth-grade class at Ephraim Middle School and approved by the city council on 5 February 2020, according to Flags of the World citing the Sanpete Messenger; Wikidata also gives 5 February 2020).
